description: This file provides AVX2 support functions for OFH Compression algorithms, including vectorized min/max and absolute value calculations for IQ samples in resource blocks, utilizing AVX2 intrinsics.

methods.name: find_rbs_abs_min_max_values
methods.description: Calculates the absolute minimum or maximum 16-bit sample values across two resource blocks using AVX2 intrinsics, based on the comparator template parameter.

methods.name: calculate_max_abs
methods.description: Calculates the maximum absolute value of IQ samples in two resource blocks by reorganizing input vectors and utilizing the min/max functions.
